name: BOCP - Business Online Control Panel
description:
Connect Claude to your BOCP ERP account and ask about your business in plain language: "how were sales last month compared to the month before?", "show me daily invoiced value for the last 30 days", "which indicators are available?".
BOCP is a cloud ERP used by companies in Romania and the region for invoicing, stock, sales and operations. 
This connector gives Claude only access to the business indicators already calculated in your account, so you can explore trends and compare periods without exporting reports or building spreadsheets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BOCP - Business Online Control Panel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BOCP - Business Online Control Panel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://secure.bocp.eu/app/rest/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BOCP - Business Online Control Panel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BOCP - Business Online Control Panel provides these MCP tools: get_business_indicator_period, get_business_indicator_values, and list_business_indicators.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BOCP - Business Online Control Panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BOCP - Business Online Control Panel in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does BOCP - Business Online Control Panel MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BOCP - Business Online Control Panel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops BOCP - Business Online Control Panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: BOCP - Business Online Control Panel is developed by Real Life SRL. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
